purpose: Six hand-painted sequential right-facing walking poses for classic adventure game; fictional visual reconstruction, not an authenticated historical portrait.
bbox_convention: cell-relative [left, top, right exclusive, bottom exclusive]; alpha_gt_0 includes low-alpha generator noise; alpha_gt_8 defines visible silhouette.
common_crop_method: Union of all six cell-relative alpha>8 bounding boxes, expanded 8 pixels and clipped to 512x512; same crop applied to every frame. Original generated PNG bytes unchanged.
rendering_note: Use identical crop dimensions, scale and anchor for every pose; never fit each silhouette separately. Slight generated body bob and foot baseline differences remain.

visual_qa.assessment: Six articulated poses with differing hands, coat hems, leg angles and foot positions. Retry reduced exaggerated knee lift. Same right-facing character and patched clothes throughout; small hand-painted variations and some higher knee lift remain.

prompt:
Create a production-ready painted 2D WALK-CYCLE SPRITE SHEET for the man HENRY shown in reference image 1. Preserve his exact character identity and outfit: young adult sailor, dark curly hair and short dark beard, gray ribbed wool cap, patched weathered gray-green jacket over mustard shirt, patched brown trousers with rolled cuffs and rugged brown lace-up boots. Reference image 2 is the camp painting: match its fine watercolor/gouache brushwork, warm muted natural colors, gentle linework, illustrated historical adventure style. This is fictional casting, not a historical portrait.

OUTPUT EXACTLY a 1536 x 1024 RGBA PNG with REAL TRANSPARENT alpha background. EXACTLY THREE columns by TWO rows of equal 512 x 512 cells, SIX full-body poses reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No captions, no text, no grid lines, no borders, no numbers, no ground/shadow/background, no objects or additional characters. Each cell contains ONLY ONE full-body Henry, facing RIGHT in consistent near-side profile, same face, outfit, proportions, scale, and horizontal anchor. Head around local y=40, boots ground contact local y=480, whole character within local x=60..452. Consistent ground line and the same height in every cell; modest believable vertical bob only.

These SIX frames must be GENUINELY DIFFERENT SEQUENTIAL POSES of one complete repeating WALK CYCLE, with articulated knees, ankles, hip movement, alternating legs, counter-swinging arms, shifting coat hem; NOT six idle standing duplicates and NOT rigid rubber limb transforms. Anatomical consistency is essential. Frame 1 left leg forward heel contact and right leg back toe contact, right arm forward left arm back. Frame 2 left foot planted under weight, body sinks slightly, right rear knee lifts forward, arms pass. Frame 3 right knee passes in front, left supporting leg near vertical, body rises. Frame 4 right foot forward heel contact, left foot back toe contact, left arm forward and right arm back. Frame 5 right foot planted under weight, body sinks slightly, left rear knee lifts forward, arms pass. Frame 6 left knee passes in front, right supporting leg near vertical, body rises, ready to loop to Frame 1. Show real visible stride silhouettes, both boots and hands, all heads and feet fully uncropped. Keep expression thoughtful but alert, energetic natural walking. Do not copy the standing reference pose.
QUALITY CORRECTION: This is ordinary low-knee WALKING, never marching or running. Passing foot barely clears the floor, knee only gently bent; do NOT lift a thigh horizontally or raise a boot to shin/knee height. Torso upright with slight natural forward lean. Keep head center at cell x=256 for EVERY frame and foot-ground y=480. In frame 3 trailing foot swings low past the ankle of the planted leg. In frame 6 other foot swings low past the ankle. Make frames 4-6 use the OPPOSITE near/far leg and arm to frames 1-3, not copies of the same poses. Preserve moderate stride and warm original painted style.
